notes: Purchase requests (PR_ORDER_REQUEST, types EFFECT 7 / TRNS_TYPE 13; unused, no types configured): numbering (DATE_SERIAL per store/date), store from type, offline-branch check, BASIC_QTY / supplier derivations, lock of converted lines (APP_RULES_SA); actions TO_PO / TO_RFQ = legacy buttons 'عمل أمر شراء' / 'عمل طلب عرض أسعار' (APP_CONV) Wave 3b: request-type and order-type lists, supplier and unit lists, item name and the item's outstanding purchase quantity (CHK_OUTSTANDING_QTY formula) on each line.

warnings.name: كمية لم يتم إستلامها

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 13) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

info.name: OUTSTANDING
info.label_a: كميات أوامر شراء لم يتم إستلامها

PR_ORDER_REQUEST.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 7 and trns_type = 13 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_ORDER_REQUEST.REQUISITION_TYPE.lov: select serial || ' - ' || nvl(name_a, name_e) d, serial r from st_pr_order_types order by 2

PR_ORDER_DET_REQUEST.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

PR_ORDER_DET_REQUEST.SUPP_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_ORDER_SRVC_REQUEST.SUPP_CODE_SRVC.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_ORDER_ASST_REQUEST.SUPP_CODE_ASST.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_ORDER_DET_REQUEST.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)

PR_ORDER_DET_REQUEST.OUTSTANDING_QTY.sql: ((select nvl(sum(o.quantity), 0) from pr_order_det o where o.group_code = t.group_code and o.item_code = t.item_code) - (select nvl(sum(nvl(ld.income_quantity, 0)), 0) from pr_income_lot_det ld, pr_income_lot lm where ld.trns_type_code = lm.trns_type_code and ld.trns_serial = lm.trns_serial and ld.group_code = t.group_code and ld.item_code = t.item_code))
